game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the relic hunter must hold off ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Reverse Parade: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing. Then check parade_ok and advance.
player_objective: Protect the heart stone from ghost knights in Whisper Stones: keep parade_ok above zero until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Reverse Parade
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 7, Level 10, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

Survive for 80 seconds to complete the level.
